stem: Two deviations are unresolved: one blocks lot identity for a planned movement and one is a low-risk formatting error. Which is normally higher priority?
choices: The formatting error because it is easier to close.
The unresolved lot-identity condition because downstream genealogy could be compromised.
Treat both as equally urgent regardless of consequence.
The formatting error because records are always more important than identity.
rationale: Priority follows consequence and dependency; an unresolved identity condition can contaminate downstream traceability and therefore outranks cosmetic record work.
